short_description: Quinn arrests the suspicious messenger, revealing Captain Vex's trap and a deeper conspiracy.
weather: cool evening breeze with distant storm clouds gathering

text_blocks.content: You nod subtly to Quinn, your eyes never leaving the hooded figure. Quinn moves with practiced efficiency, their cutlass already half-drawn as they step forward.
Hold there, stranger. Captain's orders. You'll be coming with us for some questions.

The hooded figure freezes, their hands twitching toward something hidden beneath their cloak. Quinn's blade flashes in the fading light, the point resting against the stranger's chest before they can react.
Don't be foolish. Whatever you're reaching for won't save you. Now, hands where I can see them.
The hooded figure's hands emerge slowly, holding not a weapon, but a rolled parchment sealed with wax bearing Captain Vex's personal mark - a serpent coiled around a compass rose.
Quinn snatches the parchment with their free hand, breaking the seal with a practiced flick of their thumb. Their eyes scan the contents, and their expression hardens.
Captain, it's a trap. This 'map' leads to Deadman's Maw, not the Crimson Depths. Vex's ship, the Black Serpent, is waiting there with two others. They mean to ambush any captain who takes this bait.
The hooded messenger's shoulders slump in defeat. Quinn pulls back the hood to reveal a young sailor with fear-widened eyes and Vex's signet ring glinting on their finger.
Please... Vex said he'd kill my family if I didn't deliver the map. He has spies in every port. They're watching right now.
A distant bell tolls from the port's watchtower, signaling the hour.
The sea holds power that cannot be controlled, only navigated. Trust is the most valuable currency among pirates... and you've just avoided paying with your life.

Quinn looks to you, their blade still ready. The Swift Fortune's crew has stopped their work, watching the confrontation with tense anticipation. The messenger's eyes dart between you and Quinn, waiting for judgment.
